title: Minimum Cost to Cut a Stick
summary: Given a wooden stick of length n units, with labels from 0 to n, and an integer array cuts indicating positions to cut, determine the minimum total cost of performing the cuts in any order.
statement: Given a wooden stick of length n units, with labels from 0 to n, and an integer array cuts indicating positions to cut, determine the minimum total cost of performing the cuts in any order. The cost of each cut is the length of the stick being cut, and the total cost is the sum of all individual cut costs.
constraints: A cut costs the current length of the stick segment containing it.
Perform every listed cut in an order minimizing total cost.
hints: Add endpoints zero and n and sort all cut positions.
Let dp[left][right] be the cheapest way to make all cuts strictly inside that interval.
Try each interior cut first, paying interval length plus the two resulting subproblems.
Every cutting order has one first cut per interval, so minimizing over it covers all orders.
